highlights: The AI landscape sees major strides in agent reliability and efficiency, with new research tackling inherent failure modes in self-improving LLM agents and providing deep insights into production-scale agentic workloads.

Model performance and cost-efficiency remain a key focus, highlighted by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 advancements in price-performance and the introduction of advanced architectures like Motif-Mamba for long-sequence modeling.

Developer tools are evolving to address critical production challenges, including novel compilers for deep learning performance, sophisticated hallucination detection kits for RAG systems, and frameworks for granular energy attribution in batched LLM serving.

agents.title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
agents.summary: AutoFOAM is a self-evolving LLM agent that automates complex OpenFOAM Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations from natural language instructions, enabling faster prototyping and democratizing advanced CFD workflows.

agents.title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
agents.summary: This research identifies and addresses the 'Echo Gap,' a failure mode in self-improving LLM agents where incorrect memories receive inflated rewards, leading to compounding errors. The LUCID algorithm offers an answer-free solution to improve agent accuracy.

agents.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
agents.summary: A large-scale analysis of GitHub Copilot traces reveals distinctive workload properties for AI coding agents, providing empirical foundations for designing agent-native infrastructure and improving resource orchestration.

models.title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
models.summary: Motif-Mamba introduces a structured state space model that enhances Mamba's capabilities for efficient long-range sequence modeling by augmenting it with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway, improving cross-dimensional communication.

models.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
models.summary: OpenAI announces lower pricing for GPT-5.6 (Luna and Terra) and highlights its enhanced efficiency, enabling enterprises to deploy AI workflows at scale with improved intelligence per dollar.

models.title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
models.summary: This paper presents VectorRAG and GraphRAG approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks in LLMs used by SMEs, demonstrating significant improvements in response quality for reliable decision-making.

tools.title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
tools.summary: Nova is a new automated end-to-end JIT compiler for deep learning that achieves absolute control over hardware mapping, enabling aggressive whole-graph optimizations, reduced memory footprint, and performance comparable to cuBLAS and XLA.

tools.title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
tools.summary: SIRIN is a comprehensive toolkit and interactive web UI designed to detect contextual hallucinations in RAG and memory-grounded LLM systems, providing response- and span-level inspection with a lightweight plugin design for new detectors.

tools.title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
tools.summary: JouleShare introduces an attribution framework to accurately measure request-level energy consumption in batched LLM serving, revealing that token-proportional attribution is unreliable and providing a calibrated model for fairer cost accounting.

companies.title: Apple is getting this wrong
companies.summary: OpenAI publicly addresses Apple's lawsuit, correcting claims about its employees and sharing documented messages, indicating escalating legal and competitive tensions in the AI industry.

companies.title: Building abundant intelligence
companies.summary: OpenAI outlines its full-stack strategy to make advanced AI more capable, affordable, and widely useful, covering advancements across models, inference, and agentic workflows to deliver more intelligence per dollar.

companies.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
companies.summary: Google announces new capabilities for Managed Agents in Gemini API, including 3.6 Flash and hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Google's Kaggle AI Agents Intensive course successfully engaged 353,000 learners in a no-cost program focused on building and deploying the next generation of AI agents, signaling a massive push for developer upskilling.

learning.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
learning.summary: OpenAI is providing free access to its most advanced ChatGPT models for 100,000 academic researchers, aiming to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery by empowering the academic community.

learning.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
learning.summary: A Google AI expert clarifies the concept of 'full-stack AI,' explaining its foundational role in Google's AI strategy and offering valuable insights for anyone seeking to understand the comprehensive approach to AI development.
